method: Actual shipped script sequence, traced view registry assignments, isolated first/returning sample fixtures. DOM behavior only; no browser geometry claim.

definitions.preparedView: Requested native route mounted with prepared sample state.
definitions.registeredRendererForward: The registered route actually called another current view renderer. Its final rendered view is recorded; an older template is not forced.
definitions.nativeEntryRedirect: Actual native entry routing intentionally landed on another registered route; recorded rather than forced.
definitions.preparedUnavailableSurface: Requested route mounted but heading shows an unavailable/context-required surface. Requires domain review or richer fixture.
definitions.fixtureError: Fixture or renderer error; never treated as a passing page.
definitions.unreachable: Not inferred from absence of a literal link. Function-based or contextual navigation may be valid.

compatibilityFamilies.note: Old saved route names intentionally render the current university/email form. Contextual illustration may differ; no obsolete campus gate is forced.

compatibilityFamilies.evidence: Strict runtime function identity in every edition.

ephemeralReturnBoundaries: virtualCardAuthorize returns Approval expired after leaving; a new action needs fresh approval.
